metadata.fidelity: Composite OBB study model of the real spacecraft; source dimensions plus explicitly inferred appendage/obstacle positions, not flight CAD
metadata.occupied_geometry: Union of all11 components; every planning/swept-safety/capture consumer must use this union; no cylinder substitute
metadata.frame_definition: Translate Peters2018 interface-origin axes by the published COM(-3.905,-.009,.003)m; no principal-axis rotation

articulation.status: Declared fixed deployed-pose assumptions; current flight articulation is unknown and not certified by these radii

mass_properties.status: Published Envisat study nominal, not a current in-flight measurement; never infer a uniform mass density from these collision boxes
mass_properties.uncertainty_status: No source-backed present-day confidence interval located; any numerical uncertainty family must be a separately identified scenario assumption

source_disagreements.treatment: Retain larger published bus depth; do not interpret rounded deployed envelopes as precise component coordinates

metadata.unmodeled_detail: Small harnesses, blankets, exact instrument silhouettes, reflector curvature, appendage flexibility/articulation and current damage state are not independently enclosed
metadata.attachment_scope: Unprepared nominal bus-face candidate patches; no mechanical attachment/load/adhesion qualification. Published removal studies prefer existing launch-adapter structure.
